newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Red Box in reverse take-over.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Red Box in reverse take-over.

text.p: Red Box (Malaysia) Bhd said on Saturday that it has entered into negotiations for a major acquisition that would result in a reverse take-over.

In a short statement, executive director Surendran Palachandran requested that the company shares traded on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange be further suspended for a period of 17 days from Monday, the national Bernama news agency reported.
Bernama gave no further details about the acquisition and company officials could not be reached for comment.
The stock has been suspended since Oct 8, 1996 at the company's request. It last traded at 7.00 ringgit.
Red Box makes and sells photo albums and frames and related stationery products as well as cartons and packaging products.
